name: session-models
description: Shows the main model and its effort, the live agents by model and effort, named agent crews, and the working directory, and warns about agent crowds and huge contexts

liveAgentsWarn.title: Warn at live agents
liveAgentsWarn.description: Flag the session, and toast once, when this many agents (the main thread included) are running at the same time.

contextWarnK.title: Warn at context (thousand tokens)
contextWarnK.description: Flag any live agent whose requests carry at least this many thousand tokens of context, which it re-reads on every request.
